a: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.
A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.
Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.
Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.
Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.
Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.
Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.
Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.
The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.
Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.
Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.
The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.
Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.

First Mortal Wound at 8-10 s, Wide Slash at 10-15 s and Thrash at 1-5 s after the pull. Sand Trap is game object 180647 under a random attacker 7 s after the pull and then every 5.1-7 s; it despawns after 5 s and casts its own 25656.

Arcane Eruption has no timer: it is cast when his mana reaches 100% and at the end of a stone form, and knocks players back. Energize first comes 90 s after the pull; while the aura is up the timer does not tick, so the next Energize is 90 s after stone form ends. The three mana fiends are summoned by the script when Energize starts and despawn 10 s out of combat.

Breaking an egg within 5 yd of Buru stops him, casts Creature Special and picks a new random target with a full threat reset; the six eggs respawn 120 s after they die and the remaining ones are killed when he transforms.

At 20% he roots for 6 s, transforms (aura 24721) and removes Thorns; the first Creeping Plague comes 12 s after phase 2 starts (6 s after the 6 s transform completes), then every 6 s. His run speed starts at 50% and Gathering Speed stacks every 9 s in phase 1.
At 70% or less she lands, melees and wipes every player's threat; she starts on the ground and rises 20 yd 5 s after the pull. Twenty swarmers spawn every 60 s.

Stinger Spray has one timer with two windows: first at 10 s, then every 15-20 s in phase 1 and every 6-12 s in phase 2. Lash first comes 15 s and Thrash 10 s after phase 2 starts. Paralyze stuns a random player and the larva drags them to the altar; if it feeds, a hornet spawns and the player dies. The victim's threat is restored 10 s after the teleport unless phase 2 began first.

Strength of Ossirian is up at the pull; a crystal weakness removes it and he recasts it 45 s after the hit. Five weakness auras (25177/25178/25180/25181/25183) are cast by the crystal trigger, not by him.

Enveloping Winds clears the target's threat while the aura lasts and puts it back when it ends; his run speed ramps from 100% to 200% over the first 10 s. Sand Vortexes are unselectable and cast Sandstorm on themselves.
The first casts and the repeats are Seconds(10), Seconds(20), Seconds(6), Seconds(20), Seconds(15) and Seconds(6), which are not millisecond literals; the timer columns are 0.
Lava Bomb 19411 and 20474 only spawn game object 177704 through dummy spells 20494/20495; the patch is a game object, not a spell.
The Firesworn cast Immolate 15733, Thrash 8876 and Separation Anxiety 23492 themselves; on death they explode for 19497, or 20483 when Garr's 20482 forces the explosion.
Inferno roots him and ticks 19698 every second for nine ticks, 500 damage rising to 2500; below 5 percent Armageddon stops the fight AI.
Pyroblast's repeat is (3 + rand() % 4) seconds, not a literal; the Core Ragers cannot be killed while Golemagg lives and cast Mangle 19820 and Thrash 3391 themselves.

One shared 30 s timer casts Magic Reflection 20619 or Damage Reflection 21075 at random (`rand() % 2`); Teleport 20618 runs on two independent timers (one on his current victim and one on a random other attacker); each fires first at 10000 + rand() % 20000 and then every 20000 + rand() % 10000; every teleport resets his threat (DoResetThreat); the Ragnaros event spells 19774 / 20568 / 19773 are gossip-event casts.

Submerge starts 3*MINUTE after the pull and lasts 1.5*MINUTE; Lava Bursts are game objects 178088 and the Sons are summoned without a spell; Lava Shield 21857 comes from creature_template_addon; Intense Heat 21155 is cast by the Flame of Ragnaros trigger.

Its script has no cast; creature_spells 165020 lists Molten Bulwark 47375 every 30 s, Wide Backhand 47373 every 14 s and Crushing Slam 47374 every 16 s (seconds in that table, so the timer columns are 0). The twins share damage and healing and die together.
Fire Nova 42037 is cast 1 s after each Quaking Stomp, not on a pull timer; the eggs hatch through their own AI (42042/42044) and Quaking Stomp is capped to one target by the spell script.

Rune of Detonation and Rune of Combustion alternate on one shared 20 s timer, Detonation first (boss_thane.cpp:86, 205-223); Rune of Power 52724/52729 is recast at 75, 50 and 25 percent and its zones are first extended 7 s after the cast and then every 2 s for as long as the fight lasts (DynamicObject::Delay); the image casts Arcane Rupture and Arcane Barrage itself.
The egg phase ends when all 30 eggs are destroyed; that is DATA_EGG and not a health or aura rule, so the panel cannot show a phase-2 label for him.

The first Orb of Domination wave comes 45 s after the pull, then every 15 s; a Legionnaire or Mage has a 50 percent chance to spawn a second copy at the same corner; the wave stops at 12 dragonspawn and 40 orcs.
Failing the egg phase kills every player with Explosion 20038.
War Stomp also removes 30 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Razorgore has 225000 health while possessed and 450000 after the orb is released.
The Orb of Domination trigger channels Possess 19832 on Razorgore; the player using the orb controls him.
Summon Player fires only while Razorgore cannot path to his victim; it teleports that player to him.

Burning Adrenaline has two independent timers: one every 15 s on a random living mana user and one every 45 s on the current tank; the player casts it on themself so the cast has a player as its caster; it cannot be dispelled.
The Burning Adrenaline explosion 23478 and its instakill 23644 are declared in the script but never cast in this core; only 23620 is applied.
Essence of the Red is cast when the fight starts and lasts 3 minutes: 500 mana, 50 energy and 20 rage per second.
The intro is a gossip event: Nefarius banishes Vael with 16404 and applies Corruption 23642 for 24 s before Vael turns hostile.
Vael starts the fight at 30 percent health.
Knock Away's first timer is a random 20-25 s so it is not in the timer columns; each hit knocks the target back and halves its threat.
While engaged he disables the four trash types in his room (12459 13996 12457 12461) and re-enables them on death or evade.
Wing Buffet removes 50 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Thrash is not on a timer: every attack while he is casting a non-melee spell has a 34 percent chance to add extra attacks.
Flame Buffet is an area at the caster rather than a single-target debuff.
Wing Buffet removes 50 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Shadow of Ebonroc is only cast when the target does not already have it; it procs 23394 when the target is hit.
Thrash is not on a timer: each attack has a 33 percent chance to add extra attacks.
Frenzy (23342) periodically triggers Fire Nova 23462 from its own aura.
Wing Buffet removes 50 percent of the threat of every player it hits.
Thrash is not on a timer: each attack has a 33 percent chance to add extra attacks.
Shimmer starts at 0 and repeats every 20 s; it removes the old vulnerability and applies one of the five Elemental Shields at random.
Two of the five breaths are chosen for the lockout; breath one fires 30 s after the pull and then every 60 s; breath two fires 60 s after the pull and then every 60 s.
Every 7.5 s one affliction is picked at random and applied 11-15 times to random targets; a player carrying all five is mutated.
Chromatic Mutation (23174) with 23175 and 23177 gives the player 500 percent damage, 10000 health and 1000 percent healing.
A player with Brood Affliction: Red who dies heals Chromaggus for 150000; a mutated player's death does the same.
The event starts from gossip: two yells 7 s and 4 s apart; then he casts Nefarius's Barrier and turns hostile.
Two drakonid types are chosen for the lockout; two spawn every 6-7 s and a chromatic pair comes at 7-9 s then every 35 s until 42 drakes are dead.
Shadowblink smokes for 1 s and then teleports next to a random target; the next blink is 20-25 s later and resets the shadow bolt timer to 3-6 s.
The add waves are direct SummonCreature calls; no summon spell exists for them.
Mind control restores the victim's threat when the aura ends.
The waves stop at 42 drakes; Nefarian spawns at 40.

Nefarian is summoned when 40 drakonids are dead; he starts flying and there is no 10 s landing timer: a 100 ms transition tick starts the flight, then he lands and pauses for 1000 ms before he fights on the ground.
Paralyze teleports the called rogue to Nefarian and roots them.
One random class is called every 25-35 s including the first; a class with no living player is dropped and retried on the next tick.

The class calls are class-wide: every living player of the called class receives the effect. Only the paladin, hunter and warlock calls are casts (each player casts it on themself) and leave a cast event; the warrior, rogue, priest, shaman, mage and druid calls apply the aura directly with AddAura and leave no cast event. Only Wild Polymorph picks a random secondary target.

The first Shadow Flame is 18-25 s; the first Bellowing Roar is 25-30 s; the first Cleave is 7-10 s; those first values are random and stay out of the timer columns. The first Veil of Shadow is 15 s and the first Tail Lash 10 s; every timer counts from landing, not from the pull.
Every 5 s each called mage polymorphs a random unit from Nefarian's threat list within 60 yd of the mage: never a totem and never a unit already polymorphed; the mage is the caster.

The corrupted totems' own effects are cast by the totem adds, not by Nefarian: Stoneskin 10405, Healing Stream 10461, Windfury Totem Passive 10612 and Fire Nova 11311 triggering 11307. The schema has no add-caster row, so they are listed here; the shaman's Corrupted Totems 23425 picks one of the four totems at random.

Bone Constructs rise from every Drakonid Bones game object (179804) within 200 yd when he drops below 20 percent. This is a note and not a phase: the panel's phases are exclusive, and he keeps his ground abilities below 20 percent.
The initial Shadow Flame 22992 is a self aura cast in transition stage 0 when he starts flying; the 18-25 s Shadow Flame timer only starts once he has landed.
